# State machine

Allowed states are `proposed`, `needs-clarification`, `planned`, `ready`, `running`, `review`, `blocked`, `done`, and `cancelled`, each prefixed `factory:`. Exactly one is present. A maintainer authorizes the immutable plan plus initial, gated, control-plane, and blocked-retry readiness. The deterministic state controller may project unchanged, approved F2-F13 work from `planned` to `ready`; other workflows may request clarification, report blocked/review status, or append evidence but never broaden that authority. Re-read labels and expected head/base before every safe output. Duplicate or stale events are no-ops with an audit comment. Cancellation is allowed from every active state; blocked work resumes only after the blocker evidence changes and a maintainer reauthorizes it.
